title: Structural dynamics and anti-biofilm screening of novel imidazole derivative to explore their anti-biofilm inhibition mechanism against Pseudomonas Aeruginosa.
authors: Mehmood, Shahab; Hussain, Mumtaz; Bux, Khair; Hussain, Zahid; Raza Shah, Muhammad; Ali Jakhrani, Mushtaque; Ali Channar, Pervaiz; Begum, Irshad; Saboor, Rukhsana; Yildiz, Cem B; Ali, Kashif; Herwig, Ralf
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接、QM和MMPBSA等方法探究新型咪唑衍生物与铜绿假单胞菌LasR转录调控蛋白的结合机制，虽涉及TF-DNA相关转录因子但未聚焦DNA互作，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: The biofilm formation is still prevalent mechanism of developing the drug resistance in the Pseudomonas aeruginosa, gram-negative bacteria, known for its major role in nosocomial, ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP), lung infections and catheter-associated urinary tract infections. As best of our knowledge, current study first time reports the most potent inhibitors of LasR, a transcriptional activator of biofilm and virulence regulating genes in, Pseudomonas aeruginosa LasR, utilizing newly functionalized imidazoles (5a-d), synthesized via 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition using click approach. The synthesized ligands were characterized through Mass Spectrometry and 1H NMR. The binding potency and mode of biding of ligands. Quantum Mechanical(QM) methods were utilized to investigate the electronic basis, HOMO/LUMO and dipole moment of the geometry of the ligands for their binding potency. Dynamics cross correlation matrix (DCCMs) and protein surface analysis were further utilized to explore the structural dynamics of the protein. Free energy of binding of ligands and protein were further estimated using Molecular Mechanical Energies with the Poisson-Boltzmann surface area (MMPBSA) method. Molecular Docking studies revealed significant negative binding energies (5a - 10.33, 5b -10.09, 5c - 10.11, and 5d -8.33 KJ/mol). HOMO/LUMO and potential energy surface map estimation showed the ligands(5a) with lower energy gaps and larger dipole moments had relatively larger binding potency. The significant change in the structural dynamics of LasR protein due to complex formation with newlyfunctionalized imidazoles ligands. Hydrogen bond surface analysis followed by MMPBSA calculations of free energy of binding further complemented the Molecular docking revelations showing the specifically ligand (5a) having the relatively higher energy of binding(-65.22kj/mol).
abstract_zh: 生物膜形成仍是铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）产生耐药性的普遍机制，这种革兰氏阴性菌以在医院内感染、呼吸机相关性肺炎（VAP）、肺部感染和导管相关尿路感染中的主要作用而闻名。据我们所知，本研究首次报道了利用新功能化咪唑类化合物（5a-d），通过点击化学的1,3-偶极环加成方法合成，作为LasR（铜绿假单胞菌中生物膜和毒力调控基因的转录激活因子）的最有效抑制剂。合成的配体通过质谱和1H NMR进行表征。研究了配体的结合能力和结合模式。采用量子力学（QM）方法探讨了配体几何结构的电子基础、HOMO/LUMO和偶极矩对其结合能力的影响。进一步利用动力学交叉相关矩阵（DCCMs）和蛋白质表面分析来探索蛋白质的结构动力学。配体和蛋白质的结合自由能进一步通过分子力学能量与泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MMPBSA）方法进行估算。分子对接研究显示显著的负结合能（5a -10.33，5b -10.09，5c -10.11，5d -8.33 kJ/mol）。HOMO/LUMO和势能面图谱估算表明，具有较低能隙和较大偶极矩的配体（5a）具有相对较高的结合能力。新功能化咪唑类配体复合物形成导致LasR蛋白结构动力学发生显著变化。氢键表面分析及随后的MMPBSA结合自由能计算进一步补充了分子对接结果，显示特定配体（5a）具有相对较高的结合能（-65.22 kJ/mol）。
